_meta.hash: pandemic_hash_m2 (tools/fnv.py m2()) - CASE-INSENSITIVE, casing carries no evidence
_meta.doctrine: NARROW + CORRECT beats BIG. expected_false = S * T / 2^32. Keep T small (one model / one family) and S stays affordable. A big dictionary is self-defeating: a chance hit into it READS like a real name and destroys the readability witness.

patterns.rule: The depth-0 root node of a model is named from THE MODEL'S OWN NAME, in one of these forms (first match wins):
patterns.tail: the model name with zero or more leading family tokens stripped (global_weapon_deserteagle -> deserteagle, weapon_deserteagle, ...)
patterns.evidence: Self-referential witness: the candidate is built from the model's OWN name, so a hit is not a dictionary lookup. Corroborated by 2 pre-existing names (hp_minigun, hp_mgl) and independently by literal-mining (hp_clusterbomb / hp_moab / hp_daisycutter / hp_bunkerbuster / hp_grapplinghook were reached BOTH by this rule AND by hashing mined Lua/ECS tokens).
patterns.generalizes_beyond_weapons: YES - also cracked global_pickup_ammo -> hp_ammo, global_deliverycrate -> hp_deliverycrate, {al,ch,gr,pr,up,vz}_deliverycrate -> hp_<x>_deliverycrate, global_zippo -> hp_zippo, global_munitions_* -> hp_munitions_*

patterns.rule: The named node `magazineA` is a SWIT (switch) parent with exactly two alternate children:

children.magazineA_loaded: 0x3DF6AA10 - the magazine as fitted in the weapon
children.magazineA_prop: 0x8DE5AD74 - the magazine as a detached PHYSICS PROP (the one that drops out on reload)

patterns.evidence: Structural: both are in_swit children of magazineA on 22-29 handheld-weapon models, co-located with the parent. Semantic: loaded/prop is exactly the reload-FX switch a shooter needs. The pair reads as a coherent authored pair, not two chance strings.
patterns.corollary: `_prop` is a live suffix in this dialect meaning 'the detachable physics-prop version of this part'. Reuse it when forging other detachable parts.

patterns.status: OBSERVED (these are already-named, listed as the ground-truth dialect)
patterns.rule: Every handheld weapon carries a near-identical hardpoint set at depth 1 off the root:

nodes.hp_barreltip_a: muzzle - the far +z end. _a.._d on multi-barrel mounts (quad50).
nodes.hp_shelleject: brass ejection port. _a.._d on multi-barrel mounts.
nodes.hp_dock_left / hp_dock_right: the two HAND grip points (+x=left, -x=right, obeys the side law)

patterns.confidence: CERTAIN (pre-existing names, re-confirmed here across 86 weapon models)

patterns.rule: Emplaced/mounted weapons (dshk, m60, mk19, tow, recoilessrifle, m250cal, tripodmount, quad50) add a destructible base + a traverse chain:

nodes.hp_gunmount_a: the gun attach on the pitch bone

patterns.status: FREE WITNESS - used to reject candidates, never to accept them alone
patterns.rule: +x = LEFT (99.8%), -x = RIGHT (98.4%). Any candidate whose side token contradicts its node's x-sign is NOISE.

weapon_vocab._use: NARROW pools. Compose prefix x mid x part x suffix and keep S in the 1e4-1e6 range against a SMALL T (one weapon's 3-10 nodes, or one shared-template hash). Quote expected_false = S*T/2^32 every time.

open_targets._note: Reported UNSOLVED on purpose. A wrong name is worse than an unknown one.

0x2C4AB49F.what: depth-1 leaf hardpoint on 23 handheld weapons (ak47, rpg, deserteagle, pistol, m4, ...). x=0 exactly (centred), y>0 (above the bore), z varies. bbox 0.03 = a locator point. state=static.
0x2C4AB49F.eliminated: EXHAUSTIVELY ruled out: hp_ + any <=6 chars, bone_ + any <=6 chars, bare <=6 chars (S=7.9e9 wildcard, expected_false 1.84, only garbage returned). Also ruled out a 18,515-name curated firearms pool.
0x2C4AB49F.conclusion: The name is >=7 characters after its prefix, or uses a prefix outside {hp_, bone_, none}. Needs a >=7-char wildcard (GPU) or a new literal source.

0xE68BCD4D / 0xA99F98B3.what: a LEFT/RIGHT PAIR at the REAR of mounted MGs (dshk, m60, mk19, tow, recoilessrifle, m250cal). +x=+0.10..0.14 (LEFT) / -x=-0.12..-0.14 (RIGHT), z~-0.6, bore height. Almost certainly the twin SPADE GRIPS / rear handles (the mounted-gun equivalent of hp_dock_left/right, which these rigs lack).
0xE68BCD4D / 0xA99F98B3.eliminated: 3,168-candidate pair-constrained sweep over {grip,handle,spade,hand,dock,...} x {l/r, left/right, lt/rt, a/b, 1/2} - no hit.
0xE68BCD4D / 0xA99F98B3.conclusion: Function is confident; the exact spelling is not. NOT NAMED.

destruction_chunk_series.what: ~247 unnamed hashes, all in_swit children of piece1a_ruin, states = break_piece|intact. They form a MONOTONE-DECREASING indexed series by model count (353, 339, 338, 316, 292, 282, 281, 257, 248, ...) = models with more debris chunks use more indices. Top members: 0x1B385A41, 0x2136251C, 0x8DCB305A, 0x9930D1D6, 0xEFD28665, 0xFB33AAB3, 0x85CFA0F0, 0x793FAA00, 0x07C3A1A3.
destruction_chunk_series.eliminated: piece1a[_ruin]_{propattach,prop,debris,chunk,part,frag}{00,0,000,a} (19,440 names); a 63,640-name stem x index sweep.

HARD_RESULT.finding: The chunks are LETTER-indexed (Xa, Xb, Xc, Xd) and the real stem's FNV internal state is RECOVERED.
HARD_RESULT.how: series-consistency wildcard: S=381,391,560, T=247, require >=3 simultaneous index hits -> expected_false ~7e-14. Returned a 4/4 hit on the stem '935k'. '935k' is NOT a name - it is a hash-STATE COLLISION with the real stem. FNV-1a is invertible, so state -> (state+a,..,state+d) is injective; P(a random state sends all 4 into a 247-set) = (247/2^32)^4 = 1.1e-29, expected count over the 1.87M states searched = 2e-23. Observing one PROVES the target set contains a real quadruple {Xa..Xd}. Monotone-decreasing instance counts 32/23/15/8 confirm an authored a/b/c/d family.
HARD_RESULT.next_step: Find ANY string X with h_prefix(X) == 0x43F535A1 (running FNV state, NOT the finalized hash). Then Xa/Xb/Xc/Xd name 4 nodes immediately, and the same technique unlocks the main 247-node series.
HARD_RESULT.already_eliminated_for_X: {'', hp_, bone_, piece1a_, piece1a_ruin_, ruin_, piece_, prop_, debris_, chunk_, break_, global_, piece1b_, piece1c_} + <=5 wildcard chars (S=1.07e9 - only the 935k collision itself came back); plus a 33,250-name curated stem list. X is LONGER than that.
HARD_RESULT.tooling: scratchpad wpseries.py (series-consistency brute) + wpstate.py (FNV state preimage search). Port to GPU for >=6-char stems.

destruction_chunk_series.method_note: Requiring k simultaneous index hits drives expected_false to S*(T/2^32)^k. At k=3-4 that is ~1e-14, so a WIDE stem search is statistically SAFE - the multi-hit constraint replaces the readability witness. This is the ONE place where going big is correct, and it found structure every narrow grammar sweep missed.
destruction_chunk_series.conclusion: HIGH VALUE - one correct stem names a whole chunk family; the main series is ~247 nodes across ~350 prop models. Biggest single lever left in the department.

notes: Two methods carried this department: (1) the ROOT RULE (self-referential - build the candidate from the model's own name; a hit is not a dictionary lookup, so it needs no readability witness) and (2) SWIT/parent structure (magazineA's two switch children). Both are NARROW and CORRECT. The big-dictionary trap was demonstrated live and negatively: hashing 6.3M console strings against 7,521 targets produced 11 hits against 11.09 expected noise - i.e. exactly zero signal, and every one of those 11 'hits' is a garbage string that a careless reader could have rationalised. Do not repeat that sweep.
